title: Chuloo/mural
why_read: A consumer language-learning app is a reasonable product but offers little unique technical substance for an engineering audience.
analysis: Mural appears to be a native iOS app for practicing a new language through conversation, likely powered by some LLM-based chat backend given current trends in language-learning apps. The description is marketing-oriented ('the app you eventually delete') rather than technical, and there's no detail about architecture, model choice, or novel techniques. It may be of passing interest to iOS/Kotlin Multiplatform developers curious about the tech stack, but as described it reads more like a product launch than an engineering deep-dive. Without more technical detail, it's hard to justify a high score for a technical digest.
